description: This header file declares internal function prototypes for the Slap Object Mapper (SlapOmo), part of the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It includes functions for managing object brokers, entities, proxies, and properties within the SLAP framework, primarily used for internal implementation and state management.

methods.name: SlapOmoGetRootObjBroker
methods.description: Retrieves the root object broker handle.

methods.name: SlapOmoGetProperty
methods.description: Gets the property of the SLAP object.

methods.name: SlapOmoSetProperty
methods.description: Sets the property of the SLAP object.

methods.name: SlapOmoReset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the SLAP object.

methods.name: SlapOmoEngage
methods.description: Engages the SLAP object for operation.

methods.name: SlapOmoCancel
methods.description: Cancels the engagement of the SLAP object.

methods.name: SlapOmoMakObjBroker
methods.description: Creates a new object broker based on token chain.

methods.name: SlapOmoGetObjBroker
methods.description: Retrieves an object broker based on token chain.

methods.name: SlapOmoGetObjEntity1
methods.description: Retrieves an object entity given a path.

methods.name: SlapOmoGetObjEntity2
methods.description: Retrieves an object entity based on a token chain.

methods.name: SlapOmoAddObjEntity
methods.description: Adds a new object entity at specified path.

methods.name: SlapOmoPopObjEntity
methods.description: Removes an object entity at specified path.

methods.name: SlapOmoDelObjEntity
methods.description: Deletes an object entity, with optional free.

methods.name: SlapOmoGetObjProxy1
methods.description: Retrieves an object proxy at given path.

methods.name: SlapOmoGetObjProxy2
methods.description: Retrieves an object proxy based on token chain.

methods.name: SlapOmoAddObjProxy
methods.description: Adds a new object proxy at specified path.

methods.name: SlapOmoPopObjProxy
methods.description: Removes an object proxy at specified path.

methods.name: SlapOmoDelObjProxy
methods.description: Deletes an object proxy, with optional free.
